title: opum-lore pane: coalesce a person's in-flight refresh, and reset refreshInFlight at session.end (LCLI-705 follow-up (a)/(b))
description:
Filed by lore-cli's session from opum-doc DEC-172 (4bi), the ONE follow-up for LCLI-705's round-2 minors (a) and (b). LCLI-705's single-flight `refresh` guard (hooks/register.tsx) currently returns early when a refresh is in flight, so a person's own press can be a SILENT no-op — new behaviour the round-2 review flagged and the shipped prose overstated.

(a) A person's explicit refresh that finds one already in flight is COALESCED, not dropped: exactly one more refresh runs after the current one finishes. Only CLOCK TICKS are skipped in flight (per DEC-172 (4bg)(c)). The pane doc (docs/reference/lore-pane-mod.md) and CHANGELOG.md must state that behaviour.

(b) The session.end hook resets `tickInFlight` but not `refreshInFlight`; it must reset BOTH, so the two in-flight guards are cleared consistently across a session boundary.

Minor (c) — an interactive top-level session keeps its pane, bounded to one repository — is ruled INTENDED by (4bi) and is NOT in scope here.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A person's explicit refresh that finds one already in flight is COALESCED, not dropped: exactly one more refresh runs after the current one finishes.
Only clock ticks are skipped in flight; a person's refresh is never a silent no-op.
The coalescing behaviour is stated in docs/reference/lore-pane-mod.md and in CHANGELOG.md.
session.end resets refreshInFlight as well as tickInFlight.
Both are proved both ways: a test shows a coalesced refresh runs (and that a tick is still skipped), and a test shows session.end clears both in-flight guards.

implementationNotes:
Implemented DEC-172 (4bi) (a) and (b) for the opum-lore pane. `hooks/register.tsx`: `refresh` is now COALESCED, not merely single-flight — a call that finds one in flight sets `refreshQueued` instead of returning empty-handed, and the running refresh loops (`do { … } while (refreshQueued)`) so EXACTLY ONE more refresh runs after it finishes; only CLOCK TICKS are skipped in flight (the tick guard, `tickInFlight`, is unchanged). `session.end` now clears `refreshInFlight` and `refreshQueued` alongside `tickInFlight`. `docs/reference/lore-pane-mod.md` and CHANGELOG.md state the coalescing (the CHANGELOG's LCLI-705 entry, still [Unreleased], is amended); as instructed I also folded in LCLI-706's optional note, so the CHANGELOG LCLI-701 entry's trailing attribution names (4bi) as well as (4at).

Proof BOTH WAYS — both runs recorded here as required:
- Run A, coalescing REMOVED (the `if (refreshInFlight) { refreshQueued = true; return; }` guard body reduced to a bare `return`): the test "a refresh during an in-flight refresh is COALESCED: exactly one more runs (LCLI-707 (a))" FAILED (the queued run's two `lore` reads did not appear; delta 0, not 2), while the session.end test PASSED. Reverted -> both green.
- Run B, session.end reset REMOVED (`refreshInFlight = false;` dropped from the session.end hook): the test "session.end clears the refresh guard, so a later refresh is not blocked (LCLI-707 (b))" FAILED (the later refresh was swallowed), while the coalesce test PASSED. Reverted -> both green.

Each mutation was applied with everything else in place, and the reverted tree is the intended change only (`git diff --stat hooks/register.tsx` = 20 insertions, 5 deletions).

Gates: `bun run test:mod` 69 pass / 0 fail (mod typecheck clean); `bun test` 5008 pass / 2 skip / 0 fail; `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck` and `bun run lore check` (exit 0) green.
finalSummary: DEC-172 (4bi) (a)/(b): the opum-lore pane's refresh is COALESCED — a call finding one already in flight runs exactly one more refresh after the current one finishes, so a person's press is never a silent no-op, and only clock ticks are skipped in flight — and session.end clears refreshInFlight and refreshQueued as well as tickInFlight. Stated in docs/reference/lore-pane-mod.md and the CHANGELOG (whose LCLI-701 entry now also names (4bi)). Tests proved BOTH WAYS: removing the coalescing reddens the coalesce test (run A), removing the session.end reset reddens the reset test (run B); reverted, both green. Gates: test:mod 69/0, bun test 5008/2/0, lint, typecheck, lore check exit 0. Delivered under opum-control job-1tqhv2k.
